$comment: Single source of truth for the toolchain versions CI installs (#1340 step 1).
WHY THIS EXISTS: three different Bun versions were writing and validating one
lockfile. The gates used 1.3.13, update-lockfiles.yml used 1.3.11, and seven
jobs — including the 'Fix Bun Lockfile Format' bot — used 'latest'. bun 1.3.13
writes bun.lock lockfileVersion 1; a newer bun writes 2. That is why the bot
opened a PR against every feature branch proposing a 1->2 bump plus a tree of
package upgrades, under a title that read like a formatting fix.
pnpm was 'pnpm@10' everywhere (floating within a major) while pnpm-lock.yaml is
lockfileVersion 9.0, and a developer machine was on pnpm 12 — which would
rewrite those lockfiles on the next local install.
An audit, a test run and a release build cannot be said to use the same
dependencies while the resolver version varies between them.
KEEPING IT HONEST: scripts/check-toolchain-drift.ts compares every workflow
against this file and fails on any deviation, so a new job cannot quietly
reintroduce 'latest'. Update this file and the workflows together.
